::: {#def-mh}
#### Metropolis--Hastings algorithm

Given a target posterior $\p(\vth \mid \vy)$,
a [proposal distribution](#def-proposal-distribution) $q(\cdot \mid \vth)$,
and a starting value $\vth^{(1)}$,
the **Metropolis--Hastings algorithm** produces $\vth^{(t+1)}$ from $\vth^{(t)}$ as follows
[@dobson4e, Chapter 13, p. 293]:

1. Draw a candidate $\vth^* \sim q(\cdot \mid \vth^{(t)})$.
2. Compute the [acceptance ratio](#def-acceptance-ratio) $\alpha$.
3. With probability $\min(1, \alpha)$, set $\vth^{(t+1)} = \vth^*$ (accept the candidate);
   otherwise set $\vth^{(t+1)} = \vth^{(t)}$ (reject it).
:::
